name: slides2pdf
title: Slides2PDF
description: On-device conversion of slides, documents, spreadsheets, images, and more to PDF.
author: bertro

commands.name: convert-to-pdf
commands.title: Convert to PDF
commands.subtitle: Slides2PDF
commands.description: Convert files selected in Finder to PDF using Keynote, Microsoft Office, LibreOffice, sips, or the built-in text renderer.

commands.name: stop-conversion
commands.title: Stop Conversion
commands.subtitle: Slides2PDF
commands.description: Stop a running batch conversion after the file it is currently working on. Assign a hotkey to this command to stop from anywhere.

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Setup Conversion Engines
commands.subtitle: Slides2PDF
commands.description: Check which conversion engines are installed, pick a preferred engine per file type, and get install help.

preferences.name: openAfterConvertSingle
preferences.title: Open when single file converted
preferences.label: Open after single convert
preferences.description: Open the generated PDF immediately when converting a single selected file.

preferences.name: openAfterConvertBatch
preferences.title: Open when multiple files converted
preferences.label: Open after batch convert
preferences.description: Open all generated PDFs after converting multiple selected files (after all conversions finish).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
